summary: A Different World is an American sitcom that spun off The Cosby Show and aired six seasons on NBC from September 24, 1987 to July 9, 1993. It originally followed Denise Huxtable and other students at Hillman College, a fictional historically black college in Virginia, and was inspired by student life at historically black colleges and universities. After Lisa Bonet left in the first season, the show shifted its focus to Whitley Gilbert and Dwayne Wayne.
one_line: A Different World is a 1987–1993 NBC sitcom spun off from The Cosby Show, set at the fictional Hillman College in Virginia.
key_facts: A Different World is an American sitcom that is a spin-off of The Cosby Show.
A Different World aired for six seasons on NBC.
A Different World premiered on September 24, 1987.
A Different World's final episode aired on July 9, 1993.
The series originally centered on Denise Huxtable, played by Lisa Bonet.
Hillman College is a fictional historically black college in Virginia.
The show was inspired by student life at historically black colleges and universities.
Lisa Bonet departed A Different World after the first season.
After Bonet's departure, the series focused primarily on Whitley Gilbert, played by Jasmine Guy.
After Bonet's departure, the series focused primarily on Dwayne Wayne, a math whiz played by Kadeem Hardison.
Whitley Gilbert is described as a Southern belle.
